hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

panes.label: Overview

text.strong: MBA in Marketing + Finance at ATLAS ISME

text: equips students with a dual-edge advantage: the creativity to shape global brands and the financial acumen to maximize enterprise value. This program blends

text.strong: consumer psychology, digital-age marketing, and international branding with corporate finance, investment strategies

text:
, and FinTech innovations.

Students gain a 360° perspective of business — learning to balance brand growth with financial sustainability, manage portfolios while designing campaigns, and lead with data-backed decision-making. With live projects, simulations, and case studies, the program prepares next-gen leaders to thrive in roles

text.strong: where strategic storytelling meets capital allocation, and innovation meets value creation.

cards.title: Integrate financial strategy with innovative marketing solutions.
Apply valuation, investment, and portfolio tools to real business contexts.
Design global marketing campaigns rooted in consumer psychology and analytics.
Harness FinTech, sustainable finance, and behavioral insights for decision-making.
Lead with ethical, socially responsible, and cross-cultural perspectives.
Deliver measurable impact through capstone projects and live corporate collaborations.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester 1 builds strong foundations in communication, AI tools, and global business, while preparing students with essential leadership, planning, and career skills.

courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.

title.strong: Modern Age AI Tools (Generative AI Tools)

courses.text: Explores emerging generative AI technologies, enabling students to apply automation, innovation, and creativity in solving complex business problems across industries.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development I: Career Planning and Goal Setting

courses.text: Focuses on self-awareness, career planning, and effective goal setting, guiding students toward professional growth, leadership readiness, and future career opportunities.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

courses.title: Marketing – The 21st Century Marketing
courses.text: Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

courses.title: Entrepreneurship & Family Business – Entrepreneurship and Family Business 101
courses.text: Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

title.strong: Business Analytics – Driving Decisions by Excel (Basics & Advanced)

courses.text: Master Excel tools from basics to advanced analytics, learning data organization, visualization, forecasting, and decision modeling to transform raw data into actionable business insights.

title.strong: Digital Marketing & Advertising – Introduction to Digital Marketing

courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME combines practical finance and digital marketing skills with AI and communication training, unlike traditional MBAs’ theory-focused and less tech-integrated approach.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Semester two enhances leadership, innovation, and sustainability skills, while deepening expertise in finance and marketing with advanced electives and globally relevant applications.

courses.title: Managing Self & People Skills
courses.text: Focuses on emotional intelligence, conflict resolution, and motivation strategies. Builds leadership and interpersonal effectiveness through roleplays, group projects, and reflective learning exercises.

courses.title: Human Centered Design Thinking
courses.text: Encourages innovative problem-solving using empathy, ideation, prototyping, and testing. Applies design frameworks to business challenges, fostering creativity and user-centric business solutions.

Examines corporate social responsibility and sustainability goals alongside structured research methodology. Encourages socially responsible business decision-making through data-driven insights and ethical frameworks.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development II: Personal Branding & Professional Networking

courses.text: Guides students in developing authentic personal brands and professional networks. Involves mentoring, social media strategy, and simulated networking events with industry professionals.

items.text: Covers valuation of securities, risk-return optimization, and portfolio construction strategies. Students apply analytical models to evaluate investment opportunities, manage risks, and align with financial objectives.

Explores principles of corporate finance, capital budgeting, cost of capital, and working capital. Students develop decision-making skills to optimize financial resources and maximize shareholder value.
Provides an overview of India’s financial institutions, markets, instruments, and regulations. Focuses on RBI, SEBI, banking, NBFCs, and their interconnections in economic growth.

Introduces strategies for personal and institutional wealth creation. Topics include financial planning, asset allocation, taxation, estate planning, and advisory services tailored for high-net-worth clients.
Examines consumer psychology, persuasion techniques, and structured negotiation frameworks. Students learn adaptive selling strategies to build trust, handle objections, and achieve win-win outcomes.
Covers product lifecycle management, positioning strategies, and brand equity building. Students analyze case studies to craft impactful brand narratives and sustain competitive market presence.

Explores consumer protection, advertising regulations, intellectual property, and ethical dilemmas. Students gain awareness of compliance requirements and responsible marketing practices in global and local contexts.

Analyzes international marketing strategies, cross-cultural consumer behavior, and global branding. Students design market entry plans addressing economic, legal, and cultural complexities in multinational business environments.

compare.title: Why our semester 2 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME integrates applied leadership, design thinking, and sustainability with industry-driven finance and marketing, unlike traditional MBA reliance on theoretical models and frameworks.
head: Subjects

Other Business Schools
rows: Managing Self and People Skills
Experiential workshops, peer feedback, and applied psychology tools for conflict resolution and motivation.
Taught as organisational behaviour concepts with limited experiential focus.
Human-Centered Design Thinking
Empathy-driven projects, prototyping, and live business problem-solving using design frameworks.

CSR, SDGs and Business Research

Surface-level functions, rarely linked to decision making.
Career & Leadership Development II
Focus on personal branding, networking simulations, mentorship, and social media presence building.
General career counselling, basic resume workshops, less focus on networking strategy.
Finance
Combines portfolio management, corporate finance, Indian financial systems, and wealth strategies with case studies and market simulations.
Finance taught as siloed subjects with emphasis on theory and limited simulations.
Marketing
Behavior-based selling, brand strategy, global marketing, and ethics taught via live projects, consumer labs, and international case studies.
Focus on 4Ps and consumer behaviour, with limited emphasis on global or ethical applications.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Semester three sharpens ethical leadership, economic reasoning, and cybersecurity skills, while deepening technical finance expertise and analytical marketing capabilities with advanced electives.

title.strong: Organisational Behaviour and Universal Human Values

courses.text: Explores workplace behaviour, motivation, and culture while integrating ethical values and human-centric leadership for sustainable and inclusive organisational growth.
Introduces digital risk frameworks, cyber governance, and data protection strategies. Focuses on business resilience, compliance, and mitigating threats in a technology-driven environment.
Applies micro and macroeconomic theories to managerial decisions. Emphasises cost analysis, market dynamics, policy impacts, and forecasting for strategic business planning.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development III: Emotional Intelligence & Resilience

courses.text: Builds emotional intelligence, adaptability, and resilience in leaders. Uses assessments, simulations, and coaching to strengthen interpersonal influence and long-term career effectiveness.

items.text: Focuses on building dynamic financial models in Excel, integrating forecasting, valuation, and decision-making tools. Students simulate real-world business scenarios to support strategic corporate decisions.

Explores capital structure, dividend policy, mergers and acquisitions, and risk-return tradeoffs. Students learn frameworks for maximizing enterprise value while balancing stakeholder and governance considerations.

Examines stock exchanges, trading mechanisms, and chart-based forecasting. Students practice candlestick analysis, moving averages, and momentum indicators to predict market trends and trading opportunities.

Focuses on financing new ventures, venture capital, private equity, and startup valuation. Students evaluate funding sources and financial strategies supporting entrepreneurial growth and sustainability.

Introduces data-driven decision making in marketing. Students apply statistical tools, segmentation analysis, and predictive modeling to optimize campaigns, measure ROI, and enhance customer engagement.

title.strong: Legal and Ethical Aspects of Marketing

items.text: Covers consumer rights, privacy, advertising regulations, competition law, and ethical dilemmas. Students analyze global case studies ensuring compliance while practicing responsible marketing strategies.

Explores psychological and social factors influencing consumer decisions. Students apply cognitive biases, heuristics, and emotional triggers to understand behavior and design effective marketing strategies.
Examines brand heritage, exclusivity, pricing psychology, and consumer aspiration. Students develop strategies for positioning and sustaining luxury brands in competitive global markets.

compare.title: Why our semester 3 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME blends ethics, resilience, economics, and cybersecurity with advanced applied finance and marketing, while conventional MBAs emphasize theory over practice-driven integration.

semesters.title: Semester 4
semesters.text: Semester four blends governance, analytics, and corporate strategy with inclusive leadership, while refining expertise in finance innovation and culturally responsive, sustainable marketing.

courses.text: Explores governance frameworks, ethical leadership, and legal compliance. Encourages integrity and accountability in business decision-making through case analysis and real-world governance challenges.
Introduces analytical tools for supply chain optimization. Focuses on data-driven demand forecasting, logistics, inventory management, and resilience-building in global supply chains.
Examines strategy formulation, competitive advantage, and execution. Uses case studies and simulations to connect business decisions with long-term growth and global competition.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development IV: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion in Leadership, & Capstone

courses.text: Develops inclusive leadership through DEI frameworks. Culminates in a capstone project integrating finance, marketing, and strategy for real-world business impact.

items.text: Explores valuation methods including DCF, multiples, and transaction comparables. Students assess enterprise worth in mergers, acquisitions, IPOs, and strategic corporate investment decisions.
Examines technology-driven disruptions in finance such as blockchain, digital banking, and robo-advisory. Students analyze case studies of FinTech startups and develop innovation strategies.

Introduces ESG frameworks, green bonds, and socially responsible investing. Students evaluate financial instruments aligning profitability with environmental sustainability and long-term stakeholder value creation.

Explores psychological biases, investor sentiment, and irrational market behavior. Students analyze decision-making errors and their implications for portfolio management, risk, and corporate financial strategy.

Focuses on cross-border marketing strategies, cultural adaptation, and trade regulations. Students design campaigns for global markets considering consumer diversity, localization, and international competition.
Covers eco-friendly branding, circular economy, and ethical consumerism. Students develop campaigns balancing profitability with environmental consciousness and socially responsible practices.

Analyzes influencer-driven marketing, digital content monetization, and community building. Students design campaigns leveraging creators, platforms, and analytics to drive consumer engagement and brand partnerships.
Explores ancient Indian strategic principles in governance, trade, and market regulation. Students apply timeless economic insights to contemporary marketing and business decision-making.
